name: Gatling Gun
doc: Gatling Gun (SAM08G's enemy attack; module 150 is Quistis' Gatling Gun 305's code with Chain Gun's smoke and another timeline): the root and the director - the muzzle flashes at the caster's effect point, the smoke, five misses on the line to the target and seven hits on it (with their dust and sparks), the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag150_gatling_gun.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, particle arrays and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The muzzle flashes, the smoke, five misses on the line to the target and seven hits on it (with their dust and sparks), the sound; the damage
